components.role: Serves as an alignment technique that leverages preference pairs to optimize language models without requiring a reward model.
Provides the primary capability domain where models generate executable code and program solutions.
Refers to the behavior and capability of following user instructions and constraints accurately across tasks.

target_task.text: Code generation and general instruction-following tasks.

limitation.text: Supervised fine-tuning or preference optimization for code generation often requires costly external resources such as powerful teacher models or reliable test units.

combination.text: Direct preference optimization can be combined with self-improving frameworks using behavioral consensus to weight preference pairs, improving code generation and instruction-following capabilities without external supervision.

value_prop.text: No evidence in the bundle; hypothesis to test: Eliminating the need for costly external resources like powerful teacher models and reliable test units during preference-based fine-tuning.

riskiest_assumption.text: Axis V (viability) was designated as the riskiest assumption due to missing evidence in the bundle. We assume that customers will pay for a solution that aligns code generation models using consensus-driven direct preference optimization without external supervision.

mvp.text: Customer interviews and price acceptance test to evaluate willingness to pay for a tool that applies consensus-driven direct preference optimization for code generation.
mvp.type: customer interviews and price acceptance test

success_metric.text: Proposed threshold: 40 percent of interviewed prospective users express willingness to pay for the proposed alignment approach.

kill_criteria.text: Proposed threshold: fewer than 10 percent of interviewed prospective users confirm a willingness to pay or perceive a need for self-improving code alignment.

open_source.use: Used as an evaluation tool for reward models and alignment performance.

Used as a package supporting alignment workflows.

to_build.text: A consensus-driven direct preference optimization pipeline that weights preference pairs by behavioral consensus without external teacher models.
